user_story: As a user who has forgotten their login information, I want to be able to retrieve my login details by filling out the 'Forgot login info?' form so that I can access my account. Acceptance Criteria: 1. The form must include fields for 'First Name', 'Last Name', 'Address', 'City', 'State', 'Zip Code', and 'SSN' as specified in the element inventory. 2. When the form is submitted with valid data, the user should be redirected to the next relevant page. 3. If the form is submitted without filling out any fields, the user should remain on the same page and the URL should not change.
